image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a Roseate Spoonbill standing in shallow water. The bird features distinctive pink plumage on its wings and shoulders, transitioning to white on the neck and body. Its most prominent feature is a long, flat, spatulate bill that is partially submerged or interacting with the water surface near reeds. The eye is yellow with a dark pupil, surrounded by bare skin. The background consists of blurred water and green/brown marsh vegetation.
